title: Selah · The Word that remains
description: Selah turns your church's Sunday sermon into a short study for each day of the week: a passage, a reflection and a prayer.
hero_heading: God makes Himself known in His Word.
verse_text: Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
hero_lede: Reading the Bible isn't one more task: it's how God speaks to us, corrects us and comforts us. What is preached on Sunday bears fruit when it comes back to us on Monday, on Tuesday and every day.
step1_text: Your church preaches. The sermon is where it starts.
step2_text: Selah turns the sermon into a short study for each day, reviewed by your church's leaders before it's published.
step3_text: You read the passage, reflect and pray. A few minutes that carry you through the week.
glimpse_heading: On your phone and your computer
glimpse_text: One page for each day with the passage, the reflection and the prayer. Tick off what you've read and pick up where you left off.
alt_laptop: Selah's Today page on a computer: the day's study, the week and upcoming events for an example church.
alt_phone: Selah's Today page on a phone, with the day's study for an example church.
members_text: Choose your church and start with this week's study. You don't need an account to read.
leaders_text: Selah turns each Sunday sermon into a week of studies. You review everything before it's published, and your church reads it on the web and on their phones.
